title: 第5章 帝族提亲神山凤凰老祖傻眼了第6章 别自恋了配我帝族帝子你还不够格
slug: 多子多福家族帮我攻略极品仙子
lines: 三日后。
太古神山。
这里是太古万族的祖地，连绵不绝的山脉悬浮在云端之上，每一座都散发着古老而磅礴的气息。
神光缭绕，瑞气万千，仙鹤飞舞，龙吟凤鸣之声不绝于耳。
这里是九大禁区之一，寻常人族修士，根本不敢靠近。
然而今日，一艘无比巨大的黄金神舟，撕裂虚空，在一阵阵大道伦音中，降临到了太古神山的山门之外。
神舟之上，旌旗招展，一个龙飞凤舞的“江”字，散发着镇压万古的帝威！
“人族江家？他们来我太古神山做什么？”
神山内，无数强大的气息被惊动，一道道神念扫了过来。
当他们感受到那黄金神舟上，为首的两人身上那深不可测的气息时，都吃了一惊。
“是江家家主江战，还有那个脾气火爆的三长老江守拙？！两位14境准帝巅峰强者？！”
“他们两个竟然亲自来了？难道是想和我太古万族开战不成？”
一时间，神山内气氛紧张，不少古族强者都露出了敌意。
就在这时，一个苍老而威严的声音从神山深处传出，响彻云霄。
“不知江家主大驾光临，有何贵干？”
这声音属于太古神山的守护者之一，凤凰一族的老祖，一尊活了不知多少万年的老怪物。
太古神山说有万族，实则由凤凰、黄金狮、神族三大皇族轮流把持。
黄金神舟上，江战负手而立，气度从容，朗声笑道：“凤老前辈，江某今日前来，并非寻衅，而是为我江家帝子太古神女提亲而来！”
轰！
此言一出，整个太古神山，瞬间死寂。
所有被惊动的古族强者，全都傻眼了。
提亲？
人族江家的帝子，要娶他们太古神山的神女？
短暂的死寂之后，无数太古种族心中恼怒！
“什么？我没听错吧？江家要和我们联姻？”
“开什么玩笑！他们人族的帝子，也配得上我们高贵的神山血脉？！”
“那个江家帝子江渊，不是个天生凡体，无法修炼的废物，江家是疯了吗，让一个废物来娶我们的……”
说这话的太古神山之人话才到一半，顿时如坠冰窟。
“江战！你敢！！”
神山之中，响起一阵恫吓之声。
“辱我江家帝子，死。”
江战声音平静，仿佛只是在说一件最平凡的事，
content_en:
Three days later.
Ancient sacred mountain.
This is the ancestral land of thousands of ancient races, with endless mountains suspended above the clouds, each exuding an ancient and majestic atmosphere.
The divine light is shrouded in auspiciousness, cranes are flying, and the sound of dragons and phoenixes is endless.
This is one of the nine restricted areas, and ordinary human monks would not dare to approach it.
However, today, an incomparably huge golden divine boat tore through the void and arrived outside the gate of the Ancient Sacred Mountain amidst bursts of Dao Lun sounds.
On the Shenzhou, the flags were fluttering, and the character "jiang" with flying dragons and phoenixes exuded the imperial power of suppressing eternity!
"The Jiang family of the human race? What are they doing in my ancient sacred mountain?"
Within the sacred mountain, countless powerful auras were disturbed, and divine thoughts swept over them.
When they felt the unfathomable aura of the two leaders on the golden divine boat, they were all surprised.
"Is it Jiang Zhan, the head of the Jiang family, and Jiang Shouzhuo, the fiery-tempered Third Elder?! Two 14th-level quasi-emperors at the peak of their powers?!"
"The two of them actually came in person? Do they want to start a war with our ancient tribes?"
For a time, the atmosphere in the sacred mountain was tense, and many ancient powerful men showed hostility.
At this moment, an old and majestic voice came from the depths of the sacred mountain and resounded through the sky.
"I wonder what the Lord of the Jiang family is doing when he comes here?"
This voice belonged to one of the guardians of the ancient sacred mountain, the ancestor of the Phoenix clan, an old monster who had lived for countless thousands of years.
It is said that there are thousands of clans in the ancient sacred mountain, but in fact it is controlled by three major royal clans: the Phoenix, the Golden Lion, and the Divine Clan.
On the golden divine boat, Jiang Zhan stood with his hands behind his back, with a calm demeanor, and laughed loudly: "Senior Feng, Jiang is here today not to provoke, but to propose marriage to me, the ancient goddess, the emperor of the Jiang family!"
Boom!
As soon as these words came out, the entire Taikoo Sacred Mountain fell into deathly silence.
All the ancient powerful men who were alarmed were dumbfounded.
Propose marriage?
The emperor's son of the human Jiang family wants to marry the goddess of their ancient sacred mountain?
After a short period of dead silence, countless ancient races were angry!
"What? Did I hear you correctly? The Jiang family wants to marry us?"
"Are you kidding me? The emperor's son of their human race is worthy of our noble mountain bloodline?!"
"Jiang Yuan, the emperor of the Jiang family, is not a waste who was born with a mortal body and cannot cultivate. Are the Jiang family crazy? Let a waste marry us..."
The man from the ancient sacred mountain who said this was only halfway through his words when he suddenly felt like he had fallen into an ice cave.
"Jiang Zhan! How dare you!!"
There was a sound of threats in the sacred mountain.
"Insult me, the emperor of the Jiang family, and die."
Jiang Zhan's voice was calm, as if he was just talking about the most ordinary thing.
title_en: Chapter 5 The Phoenix ancestor of the Imperial Clan was dumbfounded when he proposed marriage. Chapter 6 Don’t be narcissistic. You are not qualified to be the emperor of my Imperial Clan.
